reference_sql:
WITH lines_2024 AS (  -- one row per 2024 order line
  SELECT o.store_id,
         ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS revenue,
         ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur AS in_cents
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT s.store_code,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.in_cents THEN l.revenue ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(l.revenue), 0), 2) AS cents_pct
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN lines_2024 l ON l.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code

solver.query:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS rev,
         ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur AS cents
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT s.store_code, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN j.cents THEN j.rev ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(j.rev), 0), 2) AS cents_pct
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN j ON j.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
